text:
It is illegal to enter as a tourist with the intention to settle , you could get deported. The protocol is that the Israeli partner applies while the foreign partner is abroad. 
1. official documents need an apostille from your home country and have to be translated in Israel by a notary ( you‘ll have to send them )
2. you‘ll have to wait for an interview appointment, it can take a few months 
3 . It can take up to 1 year till the first visa.
